findings.message: This experiment is look #5 at holdout final-2020-2024, which allows 3.
Positive Sharpe in fewer than half of the volatility regimes.
PBO = 0.70 across 52 configurations: the in-sample winner lands below the out-of-sample median in 70% of the 12,870 splits.
52 trials in 'futures-trend' were evaluated on their test window; out-of-sample p-values are Holm-adjusted for that.

scorecard.label: Out-of-sample significance (Holm-adjusted)
scorecard.note: p = 0.565 raw, adjusted for 52 trials evaluated on the test window. Informational here: the sealed holdout is this experiment's confirmatory test.

scorecard.label: Deflated Sharpe ratio (in-sample)
scorecard.note: In-sample Sharpe 0.34 against an expected best-of-18.8 noise Sharpe of 0.27.

scorecard.label: Positive in volatility regimes
scorecard.note: Share of low/mid/high volatility regimes with a positive Sharpe.
